channel.title: North Wales Pioneer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from North Wales Pioneer (northwalespioneer.co.uk)

item.title: Another councillor leaves Labour as Angie O’Grady says party has ‘lost their way’
item.description: Tudno councillor Angie O`Grady says she has left Labour as the party has “lost their way” and has joined the Conwy First Independent Group.

item.title: Two solicitors from named to North Wales firm's national panel
item.description: Two solicitors have been appointed to a national panel dedicated to protecting people who lack capacity to manage their finances.

item.title: Vale of Clwyd MS calls for abolition of Land Transaction Tax
item.description: The MS for the Vale of Clwyd has called for the abolition of Land Transaction Tax (LTT)

item.title: North Wales MS on more dental practices ending their NHS contracts
item.description: I was most alarmed to hear recently that yet another six dental practices across North Wales, including Bryn Siriol in Mold, have decided to terminate their NHS contracts.

item.title: Conwy: Three charged after cannabis cultivation discovered at property
item.description: Three men have been charged in connection with the discovery of a cannabis cultivation inside a building in the Dolwyddelan area earlier this week.

item.title: 'Avoid the area' warning after crash takes place on A548 near Abergele
item.description: A crash has taken place near Abergele this morning (January 16).

item.title: Dog exercise field approved on 12‑month trial after noise concerns raised
item.description: The application, submitted by Max Jones, sought permission for the change of use of an agricultural field to a dog exercise area at Bryn Rodyn, Old Colwyn, Betws yn Rhos.

item.title: Conwy sets out new plan to tackle housing pressures and homelessness
item.description: A VISION to ensure that people people in Conwy have access to "affordable, good quality accommodation that enhances their lives and that homelessness is rare, brief and unrepeated" will be discussed by councillors.

item.title: Llandudno drama academy founder takes over reins of beloved baby music class
item.description: Catherine, who has been a music teacher for 20 years and now works at a school in Denbigh, established Mini Mozarts after having her third child.

item.title: Council backs Colwyn Bay FC upgrade despite residents’ noise concerns
item.description: The club sought permission to extend its changing rooms in line with Football Association of Wales rules, as well as retrospective approval to relocate the club shop and install new turnstiles, which have already been put in place.
